app.name: Public transport (Entur)
app.summary: When the next bus, tram, train, metro or ferry leaves your stop, from Entur's data in Home Assistant.
app.walk_hint: With a walk set, the tile says when to leave instead of the bare countdown; a departure you can no longer make is skipped.
app.late_hint: A departure that runs a minute or more late gets "+2" behind where it goes.
